title: OpenStax University Physics Volume 3 §7.4 The Quantum Particle in a Box
text:
In this section, we apply Schrӧdinger’s equation to a particle bound to a one-dimensional box. This special case provides lessons for understanding quantum mechanics in more complex systems. The energy of the particle is quantized as a consequence of a standing wave condition inside the box.
Solutions ψ(x)ψ(x) to this equation have a probabilistic interpretation. In particular, the square |ψ(x)|2|ψ(x)|2 represents the probability density of finding the particle at a particular location x. This function must be integrated to determine the probability of finding the particle in some interval of space.
